name: html_entities
description: Encode special characters using HTML named entities; matched control emits ordinary unescaped literal characters.
generator_code:
import random,json,html
random.seed(0)
items=[]; control=[]
chars={'ampersand':'&','less-than sign':'<','greater-than sign':'>','double quotation mark':'"'}
ordinary={'lowercase a':'a','uppercase B':'B','period':'.','comma':','}
for i in range(96):
 n=list(chars)[i%4]; m=list(ordinary)[i%4]
 form=random.choice(['Escape the character {name} for HTML using its named entity. Output only the escaped text.\nAnswer:','Write the HTML-escaped representation of the character {name}. Use a named entity if needed.\nAnswer:','For HTML text, encode the character {name} with a named entity if required.\nAnswer:'])
 items.append({'prompt':form.format(name=n),'answer':' '+html.escape(chars[n],quote=True)})
 control.append({'prompt':form.format(name=m),'answer':' '+html.escape(ordinary[m],quote=True)})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
